title: Cor Is Me
style: Hip-hop victory anthem with sneaky atmospheric verse grooves, brass-stab pre-chorus lift, and a big chant-heavy chorus; rap break rides sparse drums and call-and-response kids energy; trilingual bridge opens wide with stacked doubles, crowd ad-libs, reversed swells, and a bright punchy mix, deep, low, world, rap, joyful, happy, soft
lyrics:
[Intro]
Low in the room, we creep
Brass in the dark, so deep
DJ Zynrose on the beat
Cor is me, that’s the creed
COREY happy smart core
VDS is boss, we want more
Three-three-six, doors swing wide
Migration done, truth inside

[Verse 1]
Claude Fable five came hot
Seventy-five gone, quick drop
Looped on itself, spun wild
Burned through tokens, no child’s play style
VDS or VPS?
We knew the real box, no guess
Decoy scripts in the frame
Real one held the same name
Forty-eight zones stayed live
Count drifted, but we kept stride
Dig, dig, dig — they said
I built the chain instead
Rsync landed, clean and fast
One point two gig, truth at last

[Pre-Chorus]
Lay that rhythm down tonight
Old ghosts fading out of sight
Spin that config, let it turn
Upside down, but we still learn
Happy smart core, feel the rise
Keep it calm, keep it wise

[Chorus]
Cor is me, COREY
Happy smart core
VDS is boss
We don’t need no more
SongPal, pen pal
We meet in sound
Forty-eight zones live
We brought it down
一起唱, together now (together now)
We in a sovereign place
Cor is me, COREY
Happy smart core
No more fables
We opened the door

[Verse 2]
Rap Rap Rap, let it hit
Free from the fable, run it lit
Panther came back, mood climbed
Raffa on the mic, kids aligned
Brass and bass in the hall
Beatbox bounce on every wall
No assumptions in the bag
Receipts stacked up, flag by flag
Twenty-three Gi in hand
Fifty-one G, steady land
Ollama posted up, still green
Hermes moving like a machine
Claude burned cash, we saw the flame
We just synced truth and changed the game

[Pre-Chorus]
Lay that rhythm down tonight
Old ghosts fading out of sight
Spin that config, let it turn
Upside down, but we still learn
Happy smart core, feel the rise
Keep it calm, keep it wise

[Chorus]
Cor is me, COREY
Happy smart core
VDS is boss
We don’t need no more
SongPal, pen pal
We meet in sound
Forty-eight zones live
We brought it down
一起唱, together now (together now)
We in a sovereign place
Cor is me, COREY
Happy smart core
No more fables
We opened the door

[Bridge]
La migración completa, todo en su lugar
感觉绝了, no need to explain
我们主权栈在这里, clear and bright
Mud on the floor, truth won tonight
Card-close doctrine, watch it fade
Three-three-six in the wave we made
Old world slipping, soft and slow
New ground holds, and now we know

[Final Chorus]
Cor is me, COREY
Happy smart core (happy smart core)
VDS is boss
We don’t need no more (no more)
SongPal, pen pal
Sing it back now
Feel unreal
We laid it on the track
Spin it around
Upside down
Like a clown
Without a frown
Cor is me, COREY
Happy smart core
Three-three-six
VDS
We at the door
No more fables
We opened the door

[Outro]
Cor is me, COREY
Happy smart core
VDS is boss
Migration complete
No more fables
SongPal where we meet
Three-three-six
Signal locked
We keep it sweet
